interpolation_proof.constraints_per_line: vanishing on one line imposes at most D+1 linear conditions after restricting to a univariate polynomial
interpolation_proof.degree_choice: choose D=C*ceil(sqrt(n)) with C large enough
interpolation_proof.dimension_count: binomial(D+3,3)>n(D+1) for an absolute C, so a nonzero polynomial vanishing on all L exists
interpolation_proof.output: there is a surface S={F=0} of degree O(|L|^(1/2)) containing all lines of L
interpolation_proof.unknowns: dimension of polynomials of degree <=D in three variables is binomial(D+3,3)

off_surface_proof.input: a line m in M not contained in S={F=0}
off_surface_proof.intersection_bound: m meets S in at most D points, counted without multiplicity for incidence purposes
off_surface_proof.restriction: F restricted to m is a nonzero univariate polynomial of degree <=D

plain_conclusion: 当前唯一内部自足线继续推进：二分线交点界中的初等曲面层已经闭合。具体闭合了三项：用多项式维数计数构造穿过 L 中全部直线的低次数曲面；用一元 Bézout 控制不含于该曲面的 M 直线；用 quadric 退化假设处理平面/二次曲面分量。真正剩余因此缩为 ruled/non-ruled 曲面分量的 Kollár 型线计数与正特征次数截断。在该包内联前，row_column_unconditional_closed 仍必须保持 false。

plane_quadric_proof.charge: each such component contains fewer than s L-lines or fewer than t M-lines; charge at most s|M_i| or t|L_i|
plane_quadric_proof.component_types: plane or quadric irreducible/reducible components of the interpolating surface
plane_quadric_proof.degeneracy_hypothesis: no quadric contains s lines of L and t lines of M
plane_quadric_proof.plane_handling: a plane is contained in a reducible quadric after adjoining another plane, so the same s,t exclusion applies

remaining_ruled_package.non_ruled: need a self-contained proof that a non-ruled component of degree d has O(d^3) line-line intersection points among contained lines
remaining_ruled_package.positive_characteristic_cutoff: need the degree<characteristic condition, tied to |L|=O(p^2), for the non-ruled line-count theorem
remaining_ruled_package.singly_ruled: need a self-contained proof that only O(1) exceptional lines per singly ruled component can meet infinitely many component lines, while all other lines meet O(deg S_i) lines
remaining_ruled_package.why_not_closed: these are algebraic-geometry structure theorems, not consequences of the elementary interpolation/Bézout layer alone

rows.meaning: 上一证书已把真正剩余固定为二分 Guth-Katz/Kollár 线交点证明包。
用三变量多项式维数计数构造次数 O(|L|^1/2) 的曲面穿过 L 中全部直线。
不含于曲面的 M 直线每条至多贡献 deg(S) 个交点，总贡献 O(|L|^1/2|M|)。
平面/二次曲面分量由 quadric 退化假设收费到 t|L|+s|M|。
线交点证明中的初等插值曲面层已经闭合。
单 ruled 与非 ruled 分量的线计数仍需 Kollár/Guth-Katz 型代数几何包。
Kollár ruled-surface 与正特征次数截断尚未完整内联。
二分线交点界还差 ruled/non-ruled 分量计数，不能算闭合。
点-平面 incidence 依赖二分线交点界，故仍未闭合。
RNRS/Rudnev 输入仍未作者侧自足闭合。
本步只闭合初等曲面层；未宣称行/列命题无条件闭合。
